column5: One persistent authenticated stock MySQL connection drove the Rust SQL node through a real three-PD/three-TiKV topology and proved exact inclusive signed-handle ranges for all six comparisons, reversed operands, bounded intersection, disjoint not-equal, MIN/MAX points, a zero-range contradiction with null snapshot and no transport, and a stored-column residual Selection. The same Rust process followed leader stores 1->4->5->4, retained physical channel version 1 while the restarted store stream advanced 1->5, completed ordered shutdown in 125 ms, balanced accepted/completed/failed/active counts at 1/1/0/0, and passed tag-owned cleanup. Embedded jq contract tests fail closed on full-range substitution and cover exact, split, empty, and residual immutable snapshots. The source add-index workload, partitions, concurrent DDL, broad type matrix, failpoint workload, and general RealTiKV test utilities remain open.
